item: Class ability icons - Mage, Priest, Monk, Assassin

status.Priest: APPROVED by Skyy + committed (answer: "The ability icons look great, commit them")

defaults_used.frame: round dark slate frame band with a class-colour rim (bevelled, top lit)
defaults_used.background: dark field tinted toward the class colour, radial: Mage #26335e -> #0e1226, Priest #43381e -> #15100c, Monk #4a2416 -> #170b09, Assassin #33224e -> #0e0916

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.ability_does: Pick a spot within 25 blocks; after 1 s a meteor hits a 4-block area for 3.0 H. Shapes: Comet (sprint), Under Me (mid-air), Meteor on Me (crouch).
files.icon_shows: a faceted burning rock diving toward the lower left with a three-tongued fire trail (violet arcane fringe at the tail) and embers

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.ability_does: Dome placed where you look (up to 8 blocks) for 12 s; inside it, damage drains Mana instead of Health (1 Mana per 2 HP). Crouch = Pocket Dome on you.
files.icon_shows: a glassy blue hex-panel dome on a rune ring with a glowing mana crystal inside

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.ability_does: Freeze enemies within 5 blocks for 2 s (a hit breaks it after 1 s), then Chill 3 s; 1.0 H. Crouch = Deep Freeze.
files.icon_shows: a six-armed ice crystal (snowflake) with a hex gem core and six ice shards bursting outward between the arms

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.ability_does: 12 stars fall over 3 s on a 6-block area you aim at, each 0.3 H. Crouch = Star Shower on you.
files.icon_shows: three pale starlight stars (big, medium, small) falling toward the lower left with violet streak trails

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.ability_does: Channel a 20-block beam for up to 3 s that ramps 1x -> 3x (0.5 / 1.0 / 1.5 H per second). Crouch = Focused Beam.
files.icon_shows: a violet orb in a gold 4-prong cradle firing a beam of light that widens as it goes (the ramp), one rune ring round it

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.ability_does: Instant heal of 25% max Health (Priest 30%) for everyone within 9 blocks + a heal over time of 40% of it over 4 s. Crouch = Kneel.
files.icon_shows: a bold gold healing cross with flared ends and an ivory inset, bursting a 12-ray sunburst

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.ability_does: A 6-block bubble where you look (up to 8 blocks) for 12 s; its HP = 100% of your max Health; 4 heal pulses as it drops to 75 / 50 / 25 / 0%. Crouch = Around Me.
files.icon_shows: a translucent soul-cyan bubble with a highlight streak round a gold-rimmed heater shield with a soul gem

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.ability_does: Passive 30-block aura: a party member (or you) who would die survives at 30% Health if you have the Mana; per-player cooldown 12 s, doubling each save (12, 24, 48 ...).
files.icon_shows: spread angel wings and a gold halo round a glowing cyan soul flame (the guardian angel that catches a falling ally)

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.ability_does: Holy zone placed under you for 12 s, 8 blocks: allies heal 5% max Health per second and take 10% less damage. Crouch = Inner Sanctum.
files.icon_shows: a pointed (gothic) arch of ivory stone with a soul-gem keystone, holy light filling the doorway, standing in a glowing gold rune circle on the ground

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.ability_does: 75% heal on the lowest ally within 30 blocks, then chains to the next lowest, -15 per jump (75 / 60 / 45 / 30 / 15); party first, the Priest counts as party.
files.icon_shows: a big haloed rose heart with a heal plus, chaining golden light bolts to a smaller and then a smallest heart (the heal drops each jump)

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.cost_cooldown: 6 Mana + 0.5 Mana / 0.3 Stamina per s / 40 s
files.ability_does: 30 s aura, 5 blocks: enemies are Awed; every hit = 1 combo stack (max 20, 5 s decay), +2% move / +1.5% attack speed per stack. Crouch = Centred.
files.icon_shows: a glowing saffron chi orb inside three teal-white wind ribbons swirling round it, three small combo pips

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.ability_does: Single-target strike: stun 0.75 s + knockback 4 blocks, 1.2 H. Crouch = Rooting Palm (no knockback, longer stun, Awe).
files.icon_shows: an open palm thrust forward (bare hand, linen-wrapped wrist + palm band) with a saffron impact glow and 10 burst rays behind it

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.ability_does: Spinning kick: everything within 3 blocks takes 0.8 H and is pushed 5 blocks. Crouch = Leg Sweep (knock down, no push).
files.icon_shows: a kick (v4): linen-wrapped shin from the lower left, the foot standing UP at its end (toes up, sole facing the kick, heel at the bottom) in a soft earth-brown Monk shoe with a light tan sole edge, instep strap and padded collar; a long saffron whirl arc sweeping right-to-bottom and a short one upper-left, clear of the shoe

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.ability_does: Flowing Form where every 10th hit releases a shockwave on all Awed enemies (1.0 H, max one per 8 s). Crouch = Tempest Palms.
files.icon_shows: a big linen-wrapped fist (knuckles to the viewer) between two small saffron after-image fists with motion streaks, impact sparks above

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.ability_does: 10 s stance: deflect projectiles from the front, counter melee hits (1.0 H each), every counter adds Awe. Crouch = Deep Still (360-degree).
files.icon_shows: a single water drop falling toward a calm pond (two ripple rings) under a saffron sun with rays on the horizon, sun reflection on the water

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.ability_does: Invisible for 8 s (breaks on attack); First Strike: your next hit within 10 s gets +100% crit chance. Crouch = Still Shadow.
files.icon_shows: a pointed shadow-violet hood with glowing lilac eyes whose lower half fades into the dark (invisibility), and a big gold 4-point crit star (First Strike)

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.ability_does: A vial thrown where you look (up to 20 blocks): a 4-block poison cloud for 5 s, Poison 0.25 H/s + Weakened 15%. Crouch = Pool at your feet.
files.icon_shows: a tilted, corked round glass vial of bubbling green poison with a toxic green cloud spilling out behind it and drips

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.ability_does: Your next attack on a boss / mini-boss within 12 s does 2x damage, 3x on a backstab; stacks with First Strike. Crouch = Patient Kill.
files.icon_shows: a steel dagger (gold guard, wrapped grip, violet pommel gem) stabbing down through a cracked gold boss crown with rose + lilac gems

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.ability_does: Cloak + a decoy at your spot that mobs attack for 5 s; it bursts for 2.0 H in 4 blocks. Crouch = Patient Clone.
files.icon_shows: the hooded assassin in front with a glowing lilac shadow copy of itself behind and to the left, burst sparks off the copy

files.what: 64x64 RGBA ability icon; round frame, alpha 0 outside the circle and 255 inside (hard alpha only)
files.ability_does: Instant 3 s cloak + a 4-block smoke cloud: enemies inside lose you for 2 s and are Slowed 25%. Crouch = Ambush Smoke.
files.icon_shows: an iron smoke bomb with a violet band and a lit fuse, bursting into a big billowing cloud of violet-grey smoke
